d.t: CLIP ON TOP EXTENDER FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack C Top Extender is an attachment used at the top of adjustable pedestals to raise the height of pedestals by 43 mm in raised flooring systems. Extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has two clips that clip into the top of the adjustable pedestal. SikaRoof VersiJack C Top Extender is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack pedestals. Extenders are typically used to correct for differences between design plans and site conditions, as opposed to going through the process of returning a particular pedestal model and reordering the correct pedestal height model.
a: Correct the difference between design plans and site conditions
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Extenders are used with adjustable pedestals for raised flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
